units: <cite ref="Menachot 69a:3">Men. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>שתי … ה׳ שריין וכ׳</he> (Rashi) does the offering of the two loaves cause the permission to use plants which had sprouted forth at the time of the offering, or is a distinct formation of fruits required?, v. <cite ref="H01278"><he>חֲנָטָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Menachot 69a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ה׳ דפירא</he> the coming forth of the fruit, <he>ה׳ דעלה</he> of the foliage.
